scope: Inventory only. No automation cadence, ownership, commit, or editorial behavior changed in this step.

systems.owner: General public sources not delegated to a specialized monitor
schedulesManila: 08:50 first day of month — monthly sources
systems.reviewBehavior: Changed stable documents and failed checks open/update the Source freshness review queue issue.
systems.commitBehavior: Workflow commits generated freshness state/history/report to main whenever they differ.
systems.buildBehavior: Runs npm run build before publishing state.

systems.owner: Makati civic activity/discovery channels, including delegated news, events, legislation and PhilGEPS
systems.commitBehavior: Workflow commits generated monitor state/history/report to main whenever they differ.
systems.buildBehavior: Runs npm run build before publishing state.

systems.owner: Outbound URL reachability, with a critical BetterGov/BetterLGU ecosystem subset
systems.config: data/ecosystem-link-watch.json plus URLs discovered under src/content/data
systems.commitBehavior: No repository write or main-branch commit.

systems.owner: Editorial review age and declared page completeness
systems.workflow: Runs inside npm quality/build; no dedicated scheduled workflow
systems.currentRule: Every audited page must have reviewedAt and remain no more than 120 days old.
systems.limitation: Review age is independent of watched-source changes; a source may change without marking affected pages for review.

systems.owner: Published daily, weekly and monthly civic brief snapshots
schedulesManila: 09:15 first day of month — monthly brief
systems.commitBehavior: Commits a brief snapshot to main when generated output differs.
systems.buildBehavior: Runs npm run build before commit.
systems.note: A rerun replaces the same brief id with a new publishedAt timestamp, so a rerun can still produce a repository change.

systems.commitBehavior: Opens/updates a reviewable pull request instead of directly committing generated news to main.
systems.buildBehavior: Runs npm run build before opening/updating the PR.

generalSourceFreshnessVsCityMonitor.note: Same source is monitored with different semantics.

scheduleCollisions.risk: Both can rewrite generated state and commit to main.
scheduleCollisions.resolution: Source Freshness moved to 08:00, City Monitor remains 08:30, and all direct-main writers share one lock.

scheduleCollisions.risk: Multiple build/check/commit-or-PR jobs are clustered within 30 minutes.
scheduleCollisions.resolution: Direct main writers are serialized by the shared scheduled-main-writer lock; PR-only and read-only jobs do not share the lock.

scheduleCollisions.condition: Monday that is also the first day of a month
scheduleCollisions.risk: Maximum automation burst and highest chance of concurrent main-branch churn.
scheduleCollisions.resolution: Direct main writers are serialized by the shared scheduled-main-writer lock; PR-only and read-only jobs do not share the lock.

deploymentChurn.finding: General Source Freshness and City Monitor include run timestamps/history on every execution. Their workflows commit generated files whenever changed, so an unchanged source check can still create a new main-branch commit.
deploymentChurn.consequence: Every automation commit to main can trigger another Vercel deployment, contributing to build-rate pressure even when public site content did not substantively change.
deploymentChurn.civicBriefNote: Civic Brief publication is intentionally content-producing, but repeated runs can also change publishedAt.
deploymentChurn.currentBehavior: Freshness workflows publish only semantic source-state changes; scheduled direct-main writers are serialized and no-op freshness runs do not commit.

editorialBlindSpots: Reachability-only monitoring establishes availability, not whether a dynamic page's substantive content changed.
Manual-review channels still require human inspection before BetterMakati can publish a substantive civic update.

implementationUpdates.title: Remove automation collisions and no-op deployment churn
changes: Collapsed the three Source Freshness schedules into one 08:00 Philippine-time daily trigger.
The scheduled Source Freshness run uses cadence=due: daily sources every day, weekly sources on Mondays, monthly sources on the first day of the month.
Daily City Monitor remains at 08:30 Philippine time, separating the two freshness jobs.
General Source Freshness now sets publishRequired only when checked source status/error state changes or a content-hash baseline changes.
City Monitor now sets publishRequired only when source status/error state changes or a content-hash source changes.
Both workflows skip npm run build and skip commits to main when publishRequired is false.
Reachability-only body changes do not trigger publication.
Public Records and BetterMakati Status now label timestamps as published checks rather than implying every background run is deployed.
implementationUpdates.expectedEffect: Routine unchanged checks still execute, but they no longer create timestamp-only main-branch commits or Vercel deployments.
unchanged: Source ownership is unchanged and remains for 2.4C.
The four general-source/City-Monitor overlaps are unchanged and remain for 2.4C.
Editorial source-to-page dependency mapping remains for 2.4D.

implementationUpdates.title: Define source ownership
changes: Assigned every source-watch catalog entry to general-source-freshness or city-monitor.
Delegated Makati news, events, legislation and PhilGEPS to City Monitor.
The general freshness checker now skips City Monitor-owned sources.
PhilGEPS public catalog metadata now reflects the owner's content-hash monitoring semantics.
Public Records labels delegated sources as Monitored by City Monitor instead of Awaiting first scheduled check.
Build audits and browser tests protect the ownership split.
implementationUpdates.result: 112-source public catalog retained; 108 sources actively checked by general freshness; 4 delegated to City Monitor; no duplicate active freshness check for those four URLs.

implementationUpdates.title: Map sources to affected pages
changes: Added affectedPages to all 112 source-watch catalog entries.
Added affectedPages to all 8 City Monitor source channels.
Changed, failed and manual-review signals now carry page dependencies into history and reports.
Enriched currently committed source state and City Monitor state/history so mappings are available before the next scheduled run.
Build audits reject missing or unrouted page dependencies and mismatched delegated-source mappings.
Browser tests verify representative election, budget and PhilGEPS dependencies.
implementationUpdates.result: Every configured freshness source now points to at least one routed BetterMakati page requiring review when that source changes or fails.

implementationUpdates.title: Consolidate the review queue
changes: Created a persistent machine-readable freshness review queue combining General Source Freshness and City Monitor signals.
Each open item includes source, signal type, affected pages, last successful check, last checked time and required editorial action.
Created a separate resolution-state file so machine-generated queue data is never hand-edited.
Content-change items persist until explicitly resolved; failed checks clear on recovery.
Public Records is the canonical actionable queue surface.
City Monitor and Civic Briefs now route review actions to Public Records instead of maintaining separate queues.
Both automation workflows build the same queue and sync the same GitHub issue only when material state changes.
The shared GitHub issue auto-closes when no open review items remain.
currentSignals: MyMakati official social broadcasts — manual review

implementationUpdates.title: Make page freshness dependency-aware
changes: Derived page-freshness state from human page audits plus the consolidated freshness review queue.
Open dependency signals mark affected audited pages needs-review without changing reviewedAt or editorial completeness.
Published /page-freshness-state.json for machine-readable consumption.
Added explicit handling for affected routes outside the current human page audit.
Regenerate dependency-aware page freshness during normal site generation and freshness workflows.
Removed the LastReviewed fallback date and audit every usage for an explicit human review date.
Added browser and build-audit coverage for dependency flags and review-date preservation.
implementationUpdates.result: Page review age and source-change review are now separate dimensions: human review dates remain stable while unresolved dependency signals independently flag pages for re-review.

implementationUpdates.title: Integrate status and history
changes: Created a consolidated freshness history merging General Source Freshness and City Monitor published runs.
Published /freshness-history.json and keep it synchronized from both freshness workflows.
BetterMakati Status now shows open review items, pages needing source review, dependency-current pages and the affected page list.
Status links directly to the canonical review queue and freshness history.
Public Records now exposes consolidated freshness history and page-freshness state instead of presenting the general source-watch history as the primary history feed.
Updated page audits, browser tests and source/public-record audits to protect the integration.
Fixed the freshness-history builder timestamp-helper ordering before automated regeneration could encounter it.
implementationUpdates.result: Status and Public Records now consume the same consolidated freshness model while retaining concise task-led UI.

implementationUpdates.title: Harden freshness automation
changes: Repaired a malformed City Monitor freshness-review report path and restored all derived freshness files to its staged publish set.
Serialized Source Freshness, City Monitor and Civic Briefs through one scheduled-main-writer concurrency group.
Bound all three direct-main scheduled publishers to a 20-minute runtime.
Added one transient source-fetch retry for network errors, HTTP 429 and HTTP 5xx responses.
Added three-attempt fetch/rebase/push publishing with safe failure on rebase conflicts and no force-push.
Moved review-issue synchronization after successful publication so GitHub issues cannot get ahead of the published site state.
Added duplicate freshness-issue cleanup using one canonical open issue.
Preserved recovery behavior: source status recovery is a semantic change and can clear failed review items and close the review issue.
Preserved no-op behavior: unchanged freshness runs do not build, commit, deploy or update the issue.
Added a dedicated hardening audit to both build and quality.
implementationUpdates.currentIssueCheck: No open GitHub issue titled Freshness review queue existed when checked during hardening.

sourceOwnership.rule: Each freshness purpose has one authoritative owner. Public catalog entries may remain visible when delegated, but the general checker skips sources owned by City Monitor.

intentionalMultiPurposeChecks.reason: Different purposes: upstream dependency availability versus user-facing outbound-link integrity.

pageDependencies.model: Each watched source declares affectedPages using routed BetterMakati page paths. These paths travel with change/failure signals into state/history and machine-generated review reports.
pageDependencies.precisionRule: Dependencies are page-level unless the repository has a stable explicit finer-grained identifier. Do not infer exact records or service guides from a broad source.
signalBehavior: General freshness changed/failed signals carry affectedPages.
City Monitor changed/failed/new-baseline/manual-review signals carry affectedPages.
Review reports name the affected page paths.
Delegated sources use the same affectedPages in the public source catalog and City Monitor owner config.

persistenceRules: Content-change items persist across later runs until a resolution timestamp is recorded.
A newer content-change signal reopens an item resolved before the new detection.
Failed-check items remain open only while the current published source state is failed.
Manual-review channels remain actionable until resolved and reopen after a newer published monitor state.
reviewQueue.uiRule: Public Records is the only actionable list. City Monitor and Civic Briefs link to it instead of maintaining duplicate review lists.
reviewQueue.githubIssueRule: Both freshness workflows sync the same GitHub issue only on material published changes and close it when the queue reaches zero.

pageFreshness.rule: Human reviewedAt and editorial completeness remain authoritative. Open freshness-review dependencies add a separate derived needsReview state and never rewrite the human review date.
pageFreshness.currentTrigger: Open PhilGEPS content-change and MyMakati manual-review signals in the consolidated freshness review queue.
protections: Derived reviewedAt must exactly match page-audit.json.
Derived editorialStatus must exactly match page-audit.json.
needsReview must match open queue dependencies.
Open dependencies outside page-audit.json are exposed as needs-review-untracked instead of being silently treated as current.
Every LastReviewed component use must provide an explicit human date; the component has no fallback date.
Normal site generation rebuilds the freshness queue and page-freshness state before publishing.

statusAndHistory.uiRule: Show health, affected pages and history access directly; do not explain the internal freshness architecture in page copy.

concurrency.rule: All scheduled workflows that commit directly to main are serialized through one lock.

runtime.transientFetchRetry: Network errors, HTTP 429 and HTTP 5xx are retried once; ordinary 4xx responses are not retried.

publishing.conflictBehavior: Abort the rebase and fail rather than overwrite main.
publishing.movedMainBehavior: Fetch, rebase and retry push up to three times.

issueSync.title: Freshness review queue
issueSync.timing: Only after a generated-state commit was successfully pushed.
issueSync.duplicateBehavior: Use the lowest-numbered open exact-title issue as canonical and close duplicates.
issueSync.recoveryBehavior: When a material recovery publishes a zero-item queue, close the canonical issue.

hardening.noOpBehavior: Unchanged source state does not build, commit, deploy or update the review issue.
hardening.ciGuard: scripts/audit-freshness-automation-hardening.mjs runs in both build and quality.
